user_selections.question: For W05, should tracking and personalization stay off until an explicit consent choice—including for legacy records whose “true” values were generated by default rather than chosen? Existing fail-closed handling for errors and withdrawal remains unchanged.

For W05’s minimal consent/refusal record, may agents use 30 days from an explicit choice, refreshed only by another explicit choice—not ordinary browsing? Store only consent switches, scope/ownership identifiers and choice/expiry metadata; missing or expired records return to off. This does not authorize retaining behavioral data.

scope: W05 local implementation of explicit consent authority and the minimal necessary consent/refusal instruction.
constraints: Tracking and personalization remain off until an explicit choice; legacy default-generated true booleans are not affirmative choice evidence. Errors and withdrawals remain fail closed.

The minimal necessary record stores only consent switches, scope/ownership identifiers and choice/expiry metadata, for 30 days from an explicit choice. Only another explicit choice refreshes it; ordinary browsing does not. Missing or expired instructions resolve off.
This approval does not authorize retaining behavioral data or changing security-grant or erasure-witness lifetimes. Existing buffered-action purpose and customer-profile boundaries remain unchanged.

Implementation remains local under the standing W01–W41 in-order mandate, with separate independent review and batched live checks. No cloud, resource, deployment, credential, destructive or customer-data operation is authorized.
remaining: Full D06 remains pending for separately scoped behavioral retention/erasure, historical destinations and reconstruction/lifecycle decisions. This bounded approval does not establish live or customer acceptance.
